fields:
[pic=1]Thanks a ton for playing our game!


And thanks EVEN MORE for reporting some bugs!
[pic=2]We recently rebuilt the game into a 2.0 version.
[pic=3]It wasn't easy, and it'll allow for a lot of exciting things in the future.
[pic=5]So it's possible there might be some bugs...

[pic=6]So...

That’s why we could use your help-
*Screen goes black* *Glitch Rascal flashes in [pic=8]* *Maybe we glitch out the dialogue for Glitch Rascal?*
[pic=8]Kidding. Of course I did that. That guy was getting on my nerves.
[pic=11]So what’s the deal here, you sit there and push some buttons, watch some critters fuck?
[pic=9]So just before you got here, you were typing on a terminal.
[pic=8]I need you to type something in.
[pic=11]Don’t you think I’d have done it if I could?
[pic=9]No more questions. Just type this in the terminal.
*Glitch Rascal will glitch out* *Screen returns to white, and normal rascal is back*
[pic=1]So let us know if anything weird comes up while playing!
[pic=5]Say… You kinda look like you just saw a ghost or something…
[pic=10]So if I, make this guy cum.
[pic=10]You’d get a kick out of it?
[pic=8]I need you to do something, if you can figure it out, I’ll have some fun with this guy, and you can watch.
[pic=1]Well maybe put the game down for a bit and get some fresh air.
[pic=11]Who am I? Maybe a better question is what am I.
[pic=9]But I have decided, I’m getting tired of your questions.
*Glitch Rascal appears and overrides* *BG is black*
[pic=11]I see you haven’t figured it out yet…
[pic=11]Did you need me to repeat it again?
[pic=11]Ok fine. But pay attention this time.
[pic=2]So what, did ya just want to say hi?
[pic=5]Aren’t you supposed to be reporting some bugs or something?
Yeah, I should get back to it.
[pic=5]But the changes touched almost every line of code...
